description: Physico-chemical quality of untreated wastewater, south-east interceptor works, Nov. 2015 (archives) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This wastewater sampling campaign in the south-east interceptor aimed to determine the acute lethality and the physicochemical quality of the water discharged into the river without treatment during the work carried out on the south-east interceptor between 11 and 14 November 2015. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Rivers, Water, St. Lawrence River, SE, Interceptor Works November 2015. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
